systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous High-Speed Rotary P-HVEF Bottle Preform Sterilizer Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Beverage Packaging Sterilizer (FDA 21 CFR § 179.26 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 & 44-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Station Rotary Carousel with Dual-Pulsed Cold-Cathode Electron Emitters & Nitrogen Micro-Fog Curtain
systemArchitectures.shieldingType: Labyrinth Baffle Lead-Lined AISI 316L Stainless Steel (3.0 mm Pb eq)
systemArchitectures.description: High-speed rotary carousel engineered for cold-fill aseptic bottling lines. Treats interior and exterior neck finishes of PET, rPET, and HDPE preforms with pulsed high-voltage electron fog (P-HVEF) inside an oxygen-free nitrogen micro-mist envelope, achieving >6-log bacterial endospore lethality without liquid chemical rinses or thermal bottleneck shrinkage.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial Continuous Fluidized Thin-Layer Bulk Powder P-HVEF Sterilization Tunnel
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Dry Bulk Ingredient Decontamination Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 cGMP / ATEX Zone 21/22 Dust Explosion Certified)
systemArchitectures.technology: Vibratory Thin-Layer Powder Bed (0.8–2.0 mm layer) with Planar Pulsed Electron Fog Curtain & Inert N2 Fluidization
systemArchitectures.shieldingType: Labyrinth Baffle Lead-Lined AISI 316L Stainless Steel (3.5 mm Pb eq)
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for thermosensitive dry bulk food ingredients (infant milk formula, whey protein isolate, dehydrated egg albumen, cocoa, botanical extracts). Disperses fine powders across an acoustic vibratory tray under a continuous planar pulsed electron fog curtain in dense inert nitrogen, inactivating Salmonella and Bacillus spores with zero heat denaturing and >97.5% vitamin retention.

systemArchitectures.name: High-Speed Continuous Aseptic Carton Web & Polyethylene Spout P-HVEF In-Line Applicator
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Flexible Web & Spout Sterilizer (ISO 11137 / 3-A Sanitary Standard 44-03 / CE Machinery Directive)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous Web Slit Electron Emitter with Dual-Side Micro-Fog Injection for Web and Injection-Molded HDPE Spouts
systemArchitectures.shieldingType: Lead-Free Tungsten-Polymer Flexible Modular Labyrinth Barrier (2.5 mm W eq)
systemArchitectures.description: Continuous in-line roll-fed packaging web and spout decontaminator. Treats multi-laminate paperboard/aluminum/LDPE packaging rolls and molded fitments simultaneously at speeds up to 450 m/min, replacing hydrogen peroxide dipping baths with dry electron fog to eliminate chemical carryover into sensitive dairy and juice products.

systemArchitectures.name: Modular Pilot Cleanroom Multi-Geometry P-HVEF Sterilization Research Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic R&D and Process Validation Testbed (ISO 5 Class 100 Cleanroom / 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records Compliant)
systemArchitectures.technology: Configurable Multi-Axis Chamber with Tunable Pulse Forming Network (PFN: 30–100 kV, 40–300 ns) and Laser Droplet Sizer
systemArchitectures.shieldingType: Lead-Lined Heavy-Duty Dual Interlocked Shielding Enclosure (4.0 mm Pb eq)
systemArchitectures.description: Precision pilot validation skid designed for food safety microbiologists and packaging engineers establishing kinetic D10 inactivation curves, surface penetration dosimetry, and sterile barrier integrity across complex 3D container geometries and novel biomaterials.

shieldingMaterials.name: Labyrinth Baffle Lead-Lined AISI 316L Stainless Steel (3.0 mm Pb eq)
shieldingMaterials.osha1910Compliance: Fully Compliant (Exceeds OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1096 and NRC 10 CFR 20 limits)
shieldingMaterials.description: Sanitary continuous food-grade labyrinth baffle tunnel lined with vulcanized lead sheet encased between electropolished 316L stainless steel layers, ensuring zero lead exposure to product while attenuating bremsstrahlung X-rays to below natural cosmic background levels.

shieldingMaterials.description: High-density tungsten powder embedded in food-grade silicone polymer matrix, providing lead-free high-Z X-ray attenuation ideal for clean-label aseptic food processing skids requiring lightweight modular maintenance access.

regulatoryStandards.title: Ionizing Radiation for the Treatment of Food and Food Packaging
regulatoryStandards.scope: Authorizes low-energy electron beam and pulsed electrical sterilization of packaging and food contact surfaces without chemical residues.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Aseptic Packaging Equipment and In-Line Processing Skids
regulatoryStandards.scope: Requires Ra ≤ 0.38 µm (15 µ-in) electropolished product contact surfaces, complete clean-in-place (CIP) and drainability.

regulatoryStandards.title: Occupational Ionizing Radiation Safety Standards
regulatoryStandards.scope: Mandates stray dose rate outside machine enclosure to not exceed 0.5 µSv/h (0.05 mrem/h) in non-restricted operator zones.

regulatoryStandards.title: Hygienic Design of Closed Equipment for Aseptic Processing
regulatoryStandards.scope: Requires validated hermetic gas purging, bacterial barrier seals, and automated fail-safe interlocks preventing unsterilized packaging entry.
